title: Poblaciones y territorios
goal: Read how censuses, civil registration, conscription and new transport links integrated once-autonomous rural regions into the reach of the national state for the first time.
grammar: Ya no: marcar el fin de una situación anterior

items: Explain what had changed about interior regions thanks to the railroad.
State what rural communities could no longer do without state involvement.
Explain who mandatory military service brought together for the first time.
Describe the civil registry, vaccination campaigns and national censuses that reached rural communities.
Use ya no to mark the end of a previous situation.
